2122115660486734092.en_summary: Japan Q3 private consumption fell 0.3% QoQ, a wider drop than the 0.2% poll, while capex rose 1.6% QoQ beating a poll of 1.5%. Domestic demand added 0.6 percentage point to GDP and external demand subtracted 0.6 point.
2122115660486734092.zh_summary: 日本第三季私人消費季環比下降0.3%，跌幅大於預期的0.2%，而資本支出季環比上升1.6%，優於預期的1.5%。國內需求為GDP貢獻0.6個百分點，外部需求減去0.6個百分點。

2122115648285523996.en_summary: Japan Q3 GDP contracted 0.0% QoQ, just below a forecast +0.1%, and shrank 0.1% on an annualized basis versus a forecast +0.3%, down from 1.4% in the prior quarter.
2122115648285523996.zh_summary: 日本第三季GDP季環比收縮0.0%，略低於預期的+0.1%，年率化收縮0.1%，低於預期的+0.3%，前季為1.4%。

2122108220650967211.en_summary: Governor Waller opened the door to a 50bp rate hike in December. However, this view has fallen on deaf ears; even the hawks on the FOMC are not really open to the idea. Preference seems to be 25bp rate hikes spaced closer together.
2122108220650967211.zh_summary: Waller總裁為12月50個基點加息打開了大門。然而，此觀點未獲回應；即使FOMC的鷹派也不真正支持。偏好似乎是更頻繁的25個基點加息。

2122107776457433152.en_summary: Peter Schiff: Eventually interest on the national debt will consume 100% of tax revenue, though a sovereign debt and dollar crisis may hit before that happens.
2122107776457433152.zh_summary: Peter Schiff：最終國債利息將消耗100%的稅收收入，儘管主權債務和美元危機可能在此之前發生。

2122107434290331837.en_summary: When DXY rises quickly like it did last week to fresh 20 month highs it indicates the tightening of financial conditions.
2122107434290331837.zh_summary: 當DXY像上週一樣快速上升至20個月新高時，表明金融條件收緊。
